verdict.rationale: Deel's MCP server exposes tools (createTimeOffRequest, listOfContracts, calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts) that let AI agents like Claude/ChatGPT invoke Deel operations, which enables a natural-language-driven interface to the product via an agent intermediary. However, this is agent-mediated tool invocation rather than the product itself natively parsing/executing free-form NL commands, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of real-world NL command usage. Missing for 10: first-party or independent evidence of the product's own UI accepting natural-language commands directly, hands-on validation of MCP tool usage in practice, and broader coverage beyond the listed tool examples.
